$comment: Physical facts about the scenario: what depends on what. It describes the world, NEVER decisions or priorities. Judgement is the agent's job; this only tells it how reality is wired.

edges.note: The hospital hangs off this substation. Restoring it gives the hospital its grid back.
The datacenter hangs off the same substation.
The tower hangs off the same substation; meanwhile it runs on its own batteries.
The pumps are electric: with no grid, the station cannot dispense.
The traffic lights hang off the same substation.
While the tower is up, calls and messages can be made. If its batteries run out, the coordinator loses every channel for reaching anyone.
Traffic lights out and nobody directing: any journey through the area takes up to twice as long. Regulating the junction returns travel times to normal.
The tanker refills here. With the station down, once it runs dry it can no longer refuel generators.
